newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexico net internationl assets rise with debt deal.
newsitem.headline: Mexico net internationl assets rise with debt deal.

text.p: Mexico's net international assets will rise to $8.130 billion from $6.675 billion when the central bank makes its planned repayment of $1.5 billion to the International Monetary Fund, Banco de Mexico said on Wednesday.
Banco de Mexico said in a press release said that central bank liabilites with the IMF will decline in the transaction, which will take place on Thursday.
Mexico's net international assets are defined as gross international assets minus central bank liabilities with the IMF and assets of less than a six-month duration from other central banks.
